cycles_rule: After all format pilots, ceil(12 / fastest full-trial decode seconds) per context/batch, common across formats; maximum desired8 before revisiting time estimate. Freeze before main timing.
capacity_warmup_policy: 0 for boundary probes after passing full-context small-B pilot; no speed claims from un-warmed capacity timings
success: Full256output and no preemption and all-B final-length decode; exact fixed timing additionally all255decode steps at B.
failure: Insufficient-page prefill admission block or preemption may reject simultaneous capacity; arbitrary errors/timeouts inconclusive.
budget: Target<=1.75h combined; parent allows2h if needed after ETA notice.

primary_timing.end: bounds.end after all output observations and torch.cuda.synchronize
primary_timing.scope: Synchronized post-prefill diagnostic including async drain, excluding first scheduler call; not production request latency
